scenes.purpose: Hook with fifty years of rule, the sudden 1945 loss of control and the central question; then show Japan's defeat, the collapse of imperial control and the 1945 transfer of administration in Taiwan.
visuals: Japanese surrender and ROC administration cards
scenes.motion: question-first character hook followed by a continuous defeat, collapse-of-control and administrative-handover progression synchronized to narration; no static document opening

scenes.purpose: Reveal that the recipient is absent.
visuals: Taiwan silhouette suspended between empty hands
scenes.motion: camera pushes toward blank recipient line; cursor blinks twice; stamp lands off-center

scenes.purpose: Promise a historical answer.
scenes.motion: timeline races backward from 1951 to 1895; evidence markers pop in sequentially

scenes.purpose: Explain the 1895 legal transfer.
scenes.motion: arrows resolve into a treaty line; territory fill changes only after the signature animation

scenes.purpose: Compress fifty years of colonial rule without romanticizing it.
scenes.motion: infrastructure grows on one layer while restrictions close in on another; final frame locks Taiwan inside an imperial map frame

scenes.purpose: Introduce Cairo and its stated territorial purpose.
visuals: original caricature puppets of Roosevelt, Churchill and Chiang
scenes.motion: three folders slide to the center; quoted territories illuminate one by one

scenes.purpose: Connect Cairo, Potsdam and surrender into one document chain.
scenes.motion: documents stack left to right; a gold thread connects matching clauses; KEEP TAIWAN card never enters the available-options column

scenes.purpose: Show how ROC administration began before the final peace treaty.
scenes.motion: order line highlights; command arrow travels to Taiwan; map color changes with a temporary ADMINISTRATION tag

scenes.purpose: Separate surrender, administration and treaty disposition.
visuals: three transparent layers labeled surrender, administration, treaty
scenes.motion: layers separate in depth; first two receive checkmarks; treaty layer remains pending

scenes.purpose: Show the gap between the victory narrative and postwar governance.
visuals: victory banner fades into ration lines
scenes.motion: bright poster colors desaturate; charts climb; shutters close before violence is implied through shadows, never graphic imagery

scenes.purpose: Shift the policy question away from Japan's ownership.
visuals: old question: Can Japan keep Taiwan?
new question: What is Taiwan's future?
Japan claim folder moved to CLOSED shelf
scenes.motion: camera rotates around an evidence board; old question physically exits frame

scenes.purpose: Visualize the creation of two rival Chinese governments.
scenes.motion: mainland and Taiwan separate into two administrative panels; competing nameplates slide onto the same CHINA slot
audio: two stamp hits with different timbres

scenes.purpose: Present policy options and their costs.
visuals: three drawers: status quo, UN or plebiscite, military intervention
scenes.motion: drawers open one at a time; each option gains a visible cost tag; none receives a green approval stamp

scenes.purpose: Establish the U.S. position immediately before the Korean War.
visuals: China civil war file marked avoid involvement
scenes.motion: switch clicks off; U.S. token steps back from the Taiwan Strait map

scenes.purpose: Make the Korean War the episode's strategic pivot.
scenes.motion: camera starts over Taiwan, whips north to Korea, then pulls back to show the fleet route into the strait

scenes.purpose: Explain neutralization of the strait and the regional defense chain.
scenes.motion: Seventh Fleet shield expands between two shores; defense nodes connect southward

scenes.purpose: Close the door on a Japanese return.
visuals: Taiwan return request rejected before submission
scenes.motion: priorities stack higher than a tiny Taiwan card; card slides into archived imperial claims

scenes.purpose: Set up the San Francisco conference and missing Chinese participants.
visuals: two empty Chinese nameplates outside the seating plan
scenes.motion: 48 Allied flags appear as abstract ticks; camera lands on two empty seats beyond the table

scenes.purpose: Deliver the treaty wording and explain what the omission does and does not mean.
visuals: Japan claim meter drops to zero
scenes.motion: text reveals phrase by phrase; five-frame pause on absent recipient; claim meter drains only after renunciation line is underlined

scenes.purpose: Answer with three reasons and reframe the remaining ambiguity.
scenes.motion: three locks close over the Japanese claim; a separate question card remains open beside Taiwan

scenes.purpose: Leave a memorable archive-room ending.
visuals: case file labeled EAST ASIA / UNRESOLVED
Taiwan Strait map through frosted glass
scenes.motion: file closes but one red thread remains outside; room light fades after channel mark
